title: 实现typed IPC及权限策略

AC06.claim: Project selection is typed and accepts only bmdock-fixture.

AC07.claim: Renderer receives DTOs only; the official engine remains the future data owner and no direct database or vault access was added.

AC20.claim: Unknown commands, arbitrary path fields, non-fixture projects, and raw callTool-shaped DTOs are rejected.

AC37.claim: The renderer command union and Rust dispatcher expose three explicit T06 commands only.

AC45.claim: No cloud, remote, credential, or real-vault route is exposed.

AC58.claim: Capabilities are enumerated and unknown commands fail closed instead of being forwarded.

scope_limits: No Supervisor, note CRUD, real vault, search, installer, or raw MCP callTool is implemented.
P0 bmdock-probe and just contract/contract-main semantics remain independent.
